big_case.notes: Emergency application by Louisiana and Cameron Parish to vacate a published Fifth Circuit stay order in coastal-erosion litigation, presenting a circuit split over whether a post-transmittal notice of appeal under 28 U.S.C. 1447(d) triggers an automatic Griggs/Coinbase stay of state-court proceedings. While the procedural issue recurs across major federal-officer removal waves and implicates state-court comity, this interim application faced threshold vehicle hurdles (Justice Alito's recusal, FRCP 62(a), an unresolved discretionary stay request below, and the companion City of Brunswick cert petition denied on Oct. 19) and was denied by Justice Sotomayor in chambers without referral.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction made on 2026-10-15 while the application was pending (resolved 2026-10-26). Retrieval was limited to provisioned inputs, the committed statpack, and older precedents (Coinbase, Express Scripts, Western Airlines).
